checks.note: The statement excerpt is verbatim, and the axis, horizon, outcome and rationale dates all match. Two problems. (1) The proposition says the user count is 'predominantly caused by media coverage plus free availability', which spreads 'predominantly' over both causes. The speaker says it is 'predominantly the media's doing', with free access as an enabling condition. (2) The e4 excerpt is cut to the fragment 'limited impacts on actual adoption.', which drops the subject (informing workers about expert assessments) and the shift in beliefs and intentions. Out of context it can mislead.
